question: Can the public thesis and journal records for Ungson's Santa goby-fry research supply reviewable primary species data for Region I?

thesisRecord.title: Goby fry fishery at Santa, Ilocos Sur
thesisRecord.author: Julita R. Ungson
thesisRecord.physicalLocation: No location value is displayed in the public record.
thesisRecord.digitalCopyStatus: The eLib record explicitly says Digital Copy: Not Available.
thesisRecord.abstractReportedScope: Goby fry and associated fishes at Santa, Ilocos Sur; composition, distribution, recruitment length, relative abundance, and environmental parameters. The abstract reports eight coastal barangays but does not name them.
abstractReportedOtherResults: The catalog abstract says nine goby species were identified but names only the three labels above.
It reports two goby species in all eight coastal barangays and another species in six, but does not identify which names correspond to those distribution statements.
It reports associated fishes in all barangays but at a lesser degree near the Abra River mouth; no species-by-barangay or coordinate table is available in the catalog record.

It says 36 families of associated fish species were identified and seven economically important associated fish species were described; this abstract-only statement is not a verified count or accessible species list.
Recruitment lengths reported in the abstract are 22 mm for Sicyopterus and 14 mm for Chonophorus; methods and specimen-level observations are unavailable.
thesisRecord.accessAssessment: The accessible eLib record establishes bibliographic metadata and an abstract only. The thesis itself, its methods, tables, species descriptions, locality map, specimen references, and item-specific reuse terms were not available for this review.

relatedArticleLead.title: Species composition and relative abundance of goby fry and by-catch at Santa, Ilocos Sur (Luzon, Philippines)
relatedArticleLead.citation: Ungson, J. R. & R. Hermes (1985). Species composition and relative abundance of goby fry and by-catch at Santa, Ilocos Sur (Luzon, Philippines). Fishery Research Journal of the Philippines, 10(1–2), 1–8.
relatedArticleLead.retrievalFinding: The FishBase bibliography record has no DOI/ISBN and no PDF or reference URL. Searches of the public eLib record, UPV repository domain, and NFRDI journal archive did not locate this article's full text in this review.
relatedArticleLead.evidenceLimit: This secondary bibliography confirms a published article citation only. It does not establish the article's tables, taxon names, sampling sites, results, methods, vouchers, or reuse rights. Do not treat FishBase species-reference associations as verification of the sampled animals.

scopeAndLimits.waterbodyContext: The thesis catalog describes a goby-fry and associated-fish study at Santa's eight coastal barangays and mentions the vicinity of the Abra River mouth. The barangays and individual sampling locations are unnamed in the record; do not infer freshwater river occurrence, estuary boundaries, coordinates, or site-to-species assignments.
scopeAndLimits.taxonomicResolution: Only three source strings are named in the catalog abstract. Preserve Sicyoterus sp. verbatim as an unresolved source label; do not correct it to Sicyopterus or merge it with Sicyopterus lacrymosus. The remaining six reported goby species and all associated-fish names are unavailable.
scopeAndLimits.rightsFinding: The eLib catalog does not identify item-level reuse terms, and the cited 1985 article full text was not found. Record metadata and a short source-attributed abstract summary only; do not reproduce article tables, figures, thesis pages, or a species list from secondary FishBase associations.
scopeAndLimits.currentStatus: This is an early-1980s fishery study lead, not evidence of present-day species presence, abundance, fishing access, legal season, safety, or catchability.

disposition.reason: The thesis is abstract-only in the public eLib record, and the separate 1985 article is available only as a secondary bibliography citation in the sources reviewed. The incomplete source labels and unnamed barangays do not support a species checklist or locality-resolved evidence.

nextAction: If the full thesis or 1985 article becomes available through a legitimate library or repository route, verify the complete goby and by-catch lists, station/barangay crosswalk, methods, date scope, specimen identifiers, and reuse terms before creating any taxon or occurrence records. Until then, retain this as an access lead only.
